_comment: TDD M4 slice: per-route dialect override. Current Go build rejects explicit different dialect at --validate-config (milestone 4+); HTTP expectations below describe the contracted egress (provider-owned auth, dest-keyed URL/headers/classification).
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.anth]
dialect = "anthropic"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "anth-secret"
count_tokens = true

[[models]]
name = "rd-count"
provider = "anth"
model = "claude-haiku-4-5"
dialect = "openai-chat"
name: m4_route_dialect_count_tokens_away_refused
